state:
**Goal `core-class-cards`: Stage 2 (the cards) is done — every `Core` class carries its card.**
`CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs` is kept as an empty list, not
deleted: `bun nv class-cards --check` parses it and prints "every Core class carries its card", and
`tools/data/select-mutations.json` mutates it. Its two playbook bullets (`[until: gone …]` on that
list) therefore stay live, and they are still true for a class added later.

Stages 3, 4 and 5 are not started: `every_key_command_flag_and_code_is_an_index_entry` and
`every_code_carries_its_card_or_is_listed` do not exist yet, and `bun nv proofs` still owes help.
The goal prose's § *Stage 3* and § *Stage 4* are the specification; ADR 0216 is the design.

next.title: every key, command, flag and code is an index entry

items.text: **Configuration keys as index lines** — `rule:tooling/the-index-names-every-key-command-and-code`; derive one line per key from the configuration schema in `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:198` (`entries`), reached by exact name through `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:597` (`find`) and `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:619` (`show`).
**Commands, subcommands and flags as index lines** — `rule:tooling/the-index-names-every-key-command-and-code`; from `Cli::command()`, in the same `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:198`.

**Diagnostic codes as index lines** — `rule:tooling/the-index-names-every-key-command-and-code`; from the diagnostics table in `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs`, added in `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs:198`.

**The guard** — `every_key_command_flag_and_code_is_an_index_entry` in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs:45` (beside `index()`): name for name against each table, never a count. Then set the rule's `status` to `shipped` and add the test to its `guardedBy`.

backlog: Stage 4: a card beside each `Code::new` and `CODES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` — goal prose § *Stage 4*, `rule:tooling/a-diagnostic-code-carries-its-card`.
Stage 5: drain `data/proofs/help-backlog.json` and owe help for the three kinds still off — goal prose § *Stage 5*.

The pack for Stage 3 may need a `[context]` overlay naming `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs`, `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs` and the `tooling/the-index-names-every-key-command-and-code` rule — not checked whether the record has one.
